Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Applied the manual trace findings: AutoBuy now opens visible Market Board search result rows with the observed ItemSearch callback (int:5, rowIndex), preserves each result row index, and reads listing data when ListingCount is present even if WaitingForListings remains true.
